levels.surface: عبد الله بن الحسين بن زيد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: «وَ رُوِيَ» is a passive verb, not a link (RWY's reading takes «روي» as the first link, which is wrong)
«الصادق جعفر بن محمد» is named inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2), not imam_in_text
«أبيه» appears twice: the father of عبد الله, then the father of الصادق (both relation links); «آبائه» is a plural relation link
